title: Heart Weaver Sorceress
description: A mystical woman with purple hair and a golden crown stands amid dark blue and purple swirling skies, reaching upward with both hands. She is entwined with a gnarled brown tree bearing glowing yellow and red hearts, while a large green serpent with black patterns and dripping green ooze coils around her arm and releases more floating hearts.
prompt: A mystical sorceress with flowing purple hair and a golden crown stands dramatically against a swirling dark blue and purple night sky. She reaches upward, entwined with a gnarled brown tree covered in glowing yellow and red heart-shaped fruits that drip with liquid. A large vibrant green serpent with black patterns coils around her arm and releases floating hearts. Stone ruins covered in green slime appear in the background, dramatic fantasy lighting, rich vibrant colors, painterly style.
